items.q: Why does he start from a finished Excel sheet?
items.a: A short ask is not a spec. Chicken can come back as a sandwich. The sheet he already likes is the definition of done, and the skill is the walk backward.
The name and the one trigger. His X-article skill fires when a YouTube video should become a long X post. Run-the-marketing-team is too wide.

items.q: When should the steps be exact?
items.a: When the work is rules, like copying cells into a CRM. A different video every time needs room. Locking screenshots to minute marks makes a generic article.

items.q: What does the bike method refuse to remove?
items.a: The helmet. Training wheels can come off. He still will not send a judgment skill down the highway and walk away. Each run updates the file.

items.q: Who won the one live X-article rerun?
items.a: Luna, on this tape, over Terra. Soul took longer. He still keeps Astra on low across other videos. One run does not pick the model.
